name: Youzi Public AI Station (柚子的公益站)
description: A metered AI API gateway for developers outside mainland China. Browse the model catalog at https://ai.bayunzi.shop/model-plaza before signing up. For a client that supports Chat Completions, set the base URL to https://ai.bayunzi.shop/v1 and use a gateway API key. A Responses interface is also available. Rates depend on the model and service group.
